# AD5X IFS Spoolman v0.6.12-beta

Public-install portability repair.

## Fixed

- fresh installation no longer runs historical assignment-recovery logic;
- legacy assignment recovery is now migration-only and best-effort;
- missing host-side Python can no longer abort a normal install or update;
- recovery does not look for Python unless legacy assignment candidates actually exist;
- a failed optional recovery now emits a warning and continues;
- added a Z-Mod lifecycle regression check for an environment with legacy data but no host Python.

## Why

The assignment-recovery path was introduced for migration from older standalone installations and was accidentally made mandatory in the generic installer. On AD5X/Z-Mod systems where Python is available only inside the Moonraker environment, that could abort installation before the normal power-on hook was registered.

Native Fluidd compatibility remains:

- Sergey Fluidd: `v1.37.7`
- Native IFS UI patch revision: `10`
